?WORD4TODAY?

Daniel 1:9 MSG
The head of the palace staff, by God’s grace, liked Daniel…
?
It’s Grace again at work…
This Grace can make the most unlikely person like you, make an inroad for you and make available a shoulder for you to ride upon.

?? This Grace which God alone gives is upon you and it will operate in an unusual way today…it will position you for greatness.
?
This Grace will make exceeding favour and goodness from helpers flow towards you.
?You will make unprecedented inroads and breakthroughs today in Jesus name ????

????????
Have you pre-ordered for my new book on Prayer & Intercession? If not, the window is still opened at a discount.
